label: label

columns.name: AGEP
columns.description: Age in completed years. The ACSPublicCoverage task is restricted to people younger than 65.

columns.name: SCHL
columns.description: Educational attainment code: 1=no schooling completed; 2=nursery/preschool; 3=kindergarten; 4=grade 1; 5=grade 2; 6=grade 3; 7=grade 4; 8=grade 5; 9=grade 6; 10=grade 7; 11=grade 8; 12=grade 9; 13=grade 10; 14=grade 11; 15=12th grade without diploma; 16=regular high school diploma; 17=GED or alternative credential; 18=some college under one year; 19=one or more years of college credit without a degree; 20=associate degree; 21=bachelor's degree; 22=master's degree; 23=professional degree beyond bachelor's; 24=doctorate degree.

value_labels.18: some college, less than one year
value_labels.19: one or more years of college credit, no degree
value_labels.23: professional degree beyond a bachelor's degree

columns.name: MAR
columns.description: Marital status code: 1=married; 2=widowed; 3=divorced; 4=separated; 5=never married or under age 15.

columns.name: SEX
columns.description: Sex code recorded by the ACS: 1=male; 2=female.

columns.name: DIS
columns.description: Disability recode: 1=with a disability; 2=without a disability.

columns.name: ESP
columns.description: Employment status of parents: 0=not applicable; 1=living with two parents, both in labor force; 2=living with two parents, father only in labor force; 3=living with two parents, mother only in labor force; 4=living with two parents, neither in labor force; 5=living with father who is in labor force; 6=living with father who is not in labor force; 7=living with mother who is in labor force; 8=living with mother who is not in labor force.

value_labels.1: lives with two parents, both in the labor force
value_labels.2: lives with two parents, father only in the labor force
value_labels.3: lives with two parents, mother only in the labor force
value_labels.4: lives with two parents, neither in the labor force
value_labels.5: lives with father who is in the labor force
value_labels.6: lives with father who is not in the labor force
value_labels.7: lives with mother who is in the labor force
value_labels.8: lives with mother who is not in the labor force

columns.name: CIT
columns.description: Citizenship status: 1=born in the United States; 2=born in Puerto Rico, Guam, U.S. Virgin Islands, or Northern Mariana Islands; 3=born abroad to U.S.-citizen parent or parents; 4=U.S. citizen by naturalization; 5=not a U.S. citizen.

value_labels.2: born in Puerto Rico or another U.S. island area
value_labels.3: born abroad to U.S.-citizen parent or parents

columns.name: MIG
columns.description: Mobility status relative to one year ago: 1=same house; 2=lived outside the United States or Puerto Rico; 3=different house in the United States or Puerto Rico.

value_labels.1: same house as one year ago
value_labels.2: lived outside the United States or Puerto Rico one year ago
value_labels.3: different house in the United States or Puerto Rico one year ago

columns.name: MIL
columns.description: Military service: 0=not applicable, generally under age 17; 1=currently on active duty; 2=previously on active duty but not now; 3=active duty only for training in the Reserves or National Guard; 4=never served in the military.

value_labels.2: previously on active duty but not now
value_labels.3: active duty only for Reserve or National Guard training

columns.name: ANC
columns.description: Ancestry response recode: 1=single ancestry; 2=multiple ancestries; 3=unclassified; 4=not reported.

columns.name: DREM
columns.description: Cognitive difficulty involving remembering, concentrating, or making decisions: 1=yes; 2=no.

columns.name: PINCP
columns.description: Total personal income in dollars. Zero means no personal income; negative values indicate a net loss. The task population is restricted to income at or below $30,000.

columns.name: ESR
columns.description: Employment status: 0=not applicable, generally under age 16; 1=civilian employed and at work; 2=civilian employed with a job but not at work; 3=unemployed; 4=armed forces and at work; 5=armed forces with a job but not at work; 6=not in labor force.

value_labels.2: civilian employed with a job but not at work
value_labels.4: in the armed forces and at work
value_labels.5: in the armed forces with a job but not at work

columns.name: FER
columns.description: Gave birth within the past 12 months: 0=not applicable; 1=yes; 2=no.

columns.name: RAC1P
columns.description: Race recode: 1=White alone; 2=Black or African American alone; 3=American Indian alone; 4=Alaska Native alone; 5=specified American Indian or Alaska Native tribal category; 6=Asian alone; 7=Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander alone; 8=some other race alone; 9=two or more races.

value_labels.5: specified American Indian or Alaska Native tribal category
value_labels.7: Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander alone

columns.name: label
columns.description: Prediction target derived from PUBCOV: 0=not covered by public health insurance; 1=covered by public health insurance.

value_labels.0: not covered by public health insurance

task_description: Predict whether a person younger than 65 with personal income at or below $30,000 is covered by public health insurance.
